safetyBoundary: Caller must apply all common dangerous label/script/URL and source-kind guards first. Module cannot revive denied candidates.
Module never assigns action/href, executes controls, loads network data or expands permissions.
Safe source names use candidateLabel; inactive editorial headings use getSafeLabel with editable/external-label exclusion. No live input getters, innerText/textContent or whole-region prose.
No evaluation IDs, document-number values, opaque menu query values, captured full titles, indexes or expected positions used.

Root currentness compares adapter facts plus dependency element identity; optional cache must remain fresh per batch. Module itself currently recomputes relationships so even same-cache mutation rechecks remain correct.

findingsAddressed: Include actual local board heading node among dependencies; same-text replacement alters references.
Explicit incident-solving/recovery/during-outage instructions conflict with incident genre and abstain.
Pension and education application/reservation/service-entry intent abstains instead of help override.
